facts.fact: GiveDirectly's 2024 anticipatory cash programme in Ibaji verified applicants' ID and name through Smile ID, which cross-checks against telecommunications and government databases, and applicants gave their National Identification Numbers to the call centre, so enrolment in the programme depended on the check.
GiveDirectly's spokesperson said 939 applicants were excluded for failing identity verification via Smile ID, among nearly 39,000 pre-enrolled applicants in the Ibaji programme.
